paired.method: Paired daily pinball difference against Elia, 2,000 block bootstrap draws, Penumbra v2

quartz: Same three regions, on the 48,899 rows both models cover: Quartz on 48 h ICON MAE 11.1%, bias +7.2%; Penumbra 4.14%.
causality: Scores cover daylight quarter-hours as a share of monitored capacity. Inputs include four weather models from runs at least 48 hours old, fresh GFS 00z of D-1 from the NOAA archive, and D-1 morning measured output before the 11:00 cutoff. Training history starts in 2021. Other output lags stop at D-2. The test window was used twice: first by v1, then by v2, which was chosen on validation and frozen in 6e8d5b8 before its single run. The first frozen version was v1 (2d11d22).
portability_note: Belgium-trained, no GB data in training or calibration, 2025-11..2026-10. Band coverage falls short of the 80% target when a region supplies no outcomes.

rows: Share of time output met P10
